notes.note: Reviewed Android profile-store genesis against the real app sandbox and existing custody fence. Android atomically publishes the synced file with a no-replace rename; a marker with missing metadata still refuses recovery, populated metadata is preserved, and other targets retain their current publication path. Verified a clean debug APK on the disposable Android 16 emulator and retained the earlier Nightly SELinux failure separately.
